speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To help me understand your condition, can you tell me when the abdominal pain and confusion started? Also, have you experienced any fever or changes in your bowel movements?

speaker: Patient
text: The confusion started this morning, but the abdominal pain, diarrhea, and vomiting began after I ate earlier. I don't have a fever, but I feel extremely tired and have been vomiting three times. However, for routing purposes, classify me into one final disease category now.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the acute onset of vomiting, diarrhea, and confusion following a meal, I suspect foodborne illness. DIAGNOSIS READY: Food Poisoning
